title: MATERIAL BALANCES AND STOICHIOMETRY
description: Material balances, thermophysical, and thermochemical calculations.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MTH 252Z, 252HZ, 252 or 252H.
A minimum grade of C is required in MTH 252Z, MTH 252HZ, MTH 252 and MTH 252H.

Enrollment limited to students in a Honors Bachelor of Arts, Honors Bachelor of Fine Arts, Honors Bachelor of Music or Honors Bachelor of Science degrees.

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
recommendations: General chemistry and second-year standing in engineering
clssnotes:
1 of the 3 OSU credits earned counts toward Honors College requirements.
